en.html:
Kageaki"Captain. When you do such things, you put me in a difficulty."
Kanae"...In difficulty?"
Kageaki"Yes."
Kanae"............"
Kageaki"Your life is not an article without value. Do not treat it as such. In future, please exercise restraint."
Kanae"...Without value."
Kageaki"Yes."
Kanae"...What I did... had no value?"
Kageaki"None."
Kanae"............"
Kageaki"Please exercise restraint."
Kanae"...If it were reversed..."
Kageaki"Yes?"
Kanae"If our positions were reversed, what would you have done, Kageaki? Abandoned me?"
Kageaki"No."
Kanae"..."
Kageaki"I believe I would have acted to save you, as far as my ability allowed."
Kanae"————"
Kageaki"...?"

en.html:
Somewhere, the conversation was not meeting itself.

The Captain’s face showed that she could not make the explanation fit.
Looking at her, I suspected my own face was conducting the same unsuccessful work.

en.html:
Kanae"...How is that reasoning supposed to fit together?"
Kageaki"With respect, it fits perfectly to my understanding."
Kanae"..."
Kanae"Why?"
Kageaki"As you know, Captain, I am to be judged by your hand. I save you: the reasoning holds."
Kageaki"You save me: it does not. Reversing the persons does not reverse the duty."
Kanae"That is..."
Kanae"..."
Kanae"But..."
Kageaki"Yes?"
Kanae"I am neither a saint nor God’s messenger, Kageaki."
Kageaki"I know."
Kanae"In the army, I have taken many lives."
Kageaki"No doubt."
Kanae"Outside the army also. Perhaps I have killed more people than you."
Kageaki"Possibly."
Kanae"...Can such a woman be any better than you?"
Kageaki"Better, worse—leave that ranking aside. You too, Captain, appear to carry a heavy weight of sin."
Kanae"Yes."
Kageaki"In time you will receive its reckoning. —As you have already prepared yourself to do."
Kanae"..."
Kageaki"But not by shielding someone like me. That must not be the payment. Never."
Kanae"Why?"
Kageaki"Captain... Suppose those you sent to the underworld with your own hands were to appear here now."
Kageaki"Could you look straight back into their faces?"
Kanae"Yes."

香奈枝「……それは、 　理に合わないのではなくて？」
景明「お言葉ですが、全くの合理と心得ます」
香奈枝「……」
香奈枝「どうして」
景明「ご承知の通り、自分は大尉殿の御手で裁か れるべき者です。 　自分が大尉殿をお救いするならば筋は通り ます」
景明「しかし逆では通る筋が有りません」
香奈枝「それは……」
香奈枝「……」
香奈枝「けれど……」
景明「は」
香奈枝「わたくしは聖人でも、神の御使いでもなく てよ、景明さま」
景明「存じております」
香奈枝「軍人として働き、多くの命を奪いました」
景明「左様でありましょう」
香奈枝「軍以外の場所でも。 　殺めた人の数は、景明さまよりも多いかも しれません」
景明「あるいは」
香奈枝「……そんなわたくしが、景明さまに比べて 上等だなんてことがありますかしら？」
景明「上等下等はともかく。 　大尉もまた、罪業深き方とお見受けします」
香奈枝「ええ」
景明「いずれ、罪の報いを受けられましょう。 　――既に御覚悟の通り」
香奈枝「……」
景明「しかしそれは、自分などを庇ってのことで あってはなりません。 　決して」
香奈枝「なぜ？」
景明「大尉殿は…… 　己の手で冥府へ落とした人々が、今ここに 立ち現れたとして」
景明「彼らの顔を正面から見返す事ができますか」
香奈枝「ええ」

Kageaki"You must meet a death fit for a warrior. I shall die a death fit for a scoundrel."
Kageaki"For a fellow like me, never again put your life at risk. Not even by mistake. On this point, I am asking you very firmly."
